scripts.build: npm --workspace server run build && npm --workspace client run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm --workspace server run dev" "npm --workspace client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --workspace server test && npm --workspace client test
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -n jest,vitest -c magenta,blue "npm --workspace server run test:watch" "npm --workspace client run test:watch"
